title: EMTRF: Evidence-Monotone Terrain Representation Framework
description: Reference implementation and reproducibility package for the Evidence-Monotone Terrain Representation Framework (EMTRF): an operator contract carrying provenance, typed support, applicability and complete-source lineage through representation-only transformations, with Evidence-Constrained Douglas-Peucker (EC-DP) as the reference instance. One command (./run_all.sh) reproduces every value reported in the accompanying Computers & Geosciences manuscript.
